name: draggable-sticker-board
title: Draggable Sticker Board
description: A freeform pinboard surface allowing multiple graphic badges and stickers to be repositioned freely with mouse drag.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Playful
Macrostructure: Scatter
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Freeform Sticker Placement: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
